gloss: hit or miss, inconsistency in quality

definitions.gloss: hit or miss, inconsistency in quality
definitions.explanation: Variation in quality or outcome where results can be either good or bad. Often used to describe products, restaurants, or services that are unpredictable in quality.

examples.english: This shop is hit or miss.

examples.japanese: ⟦{安|やす}い→安い：00464_yasui⟧⟦ワイン→ワイン：01067_wain⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{当|あ}たり{外|はず}れ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大|おお}きい→大きい：00335_ookii⟧。
examples.english: Cheap wine varies greatly in quality.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦ブランド→ブランド：05221_burando⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{当|あ}たり{外|はず}れ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、⟦{安心|あんしん}して→安心する：06067_anshinsuru⟧⟦{買|か}える→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: This brand is consistently good, so you can buy with confidence.

notes:
USAGE:
Most commonly used in the pattern {当|あ}たり{外|はず}れ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ (there is inconsistency) or {当|あ}たり{外|はず}れ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大|おお}きい→大きい：00335_ookii⟧ (the variation is large). The negative {当|あ}たり{外|はず}れ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ means consistently good — there are no misses.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {当|あ}たり{外|はず}れ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: to be hit or miss
- {当|あ}たり{外|はず}れ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大|おお}きい→大きい：00335_ookii⟧: to have wide variation in quality
- {当|あ}たり{外|はず}れ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧: to be consistently good
- {当|あ}たり{外|はず}れ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{激|はげ}しい→激しい：02348_hageshii⟧: to vary wildly in quality
